ctx.x: Arlington Annex. I think you're right, Charles. So, I hired my band. Myself. I was playing piano. I hired P. Buckeyes to play violin. My drummer was Chris Minor. And I had three entertainers. That was Willie Jackson. Gets acquainted with Willie Jackson, when I was playing with Jack Carey's Orchestra, at the Come Clean Hall, because he lived in Gretton then. And he always asked me, he says, at times if you get a job for me to sing, I'd like to have a job to sing, because he was a songwriter. Well, I remember that.…
